'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Anderson DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
